scenes.text:
Welcome to CodeSeekho!
Today we will master Python Loops — the engine behind repetition in every program.

A loop lets you run the same block of code multiple times without copy-pasting it.
Python gives you two primary loop types: for and while.

scenes.code:
# The FOR Loop
fruits = ["apple", "banana", "cherry"]

for fruit in fruits:
    print(f"I love {fruit}!")

# Output:
# I love apple!
# I love banana!
# I love cherry!

# The WHILE Loop
counter = 0

while counter < 5:
    print(f"Count: {counter}")
    counter += 1

print("Loop finished!")
# Output:
# Count: 0  Count: 1  Count: 2  Count: 3  Count: 4

scenes.text:
You now understand Python Loops!
For iterates over sequences.
While runs on a condition.
break stops. continue skips.
Practice daily on CodeSeekho — Happy Coding!
